## Session Report

* [J-D1 report: SMEFTsim dipoles on a quark line read against its arrow](J-D1-report.md) - A two-gamma dipole chain closed at a vector sink on a reversed quark line was evaluated in reverse order, which flips the commutator; fixed by permuting the chain's gamma indices, pinned by five MadGraph standalone rows and a rooting-invariance test, with mutation evidence. A separate CP-odd W-dipole defect is characterised and filed.
